cells.C: Practice Planning Out The Proposed Steps You Will Take For Implementing Your Data Collection. Which Steps Do You Feel Are Weak Or Potentially Problematic And Why What Support Is Needed To Address Potential Concerns

I will use Qualtrics to contact participants and distribute the survey, not to recruit them. I have considered using Amazon’s MTurk because I spoke with a Capella Doctorate alumnus who described MTurk as a recruitment method, but her study was not comparative. If I can't use MTurk to recruit participants, I'll rely on a paid service like Directmail.com. Another potential weakness of my study is that many scholars believe a priori power analysis applies to every study and scenario. However, my study will rely heavily on the justification for using multiple regression. The justification comes from meeting the true assumptions of multiple regression, which I have listed below.
1. There are no influential outliers or cases that unduly distort the model (Laerd Statistics, 2026).
2. Homoscedasticity: the residuals exhibit constant variance (Laerd Statistics, 2026).
3. There is no multicollinearity; the predictor variables are not excessively correlated (Laerd Statistics, 2026).
4. Independence of errors: the observations are independent from one another (Laerd Statistics, 2026).
5. Linearity: the relationship between the independent variables and the dependent variable is assumed to be linear (Laerd Statistics, 2026).
6. Normality of residuals: the residuals are approximately normally distributed (Laerd Statistics, 2026).

7. Two or more independent variables: To have true multiple regression in this study, at least three variables exist. Multiple regression requires at least two independent variables and only one dependent variable (Laerd Statistics, 2026).
Laerd Statistics. (2026). Assumptions of multiple regression. https://statistics.laerd.com/
